headline: President Clinton changed an earlier executive order, No. 12864, but the title alone does not say what was changed.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 12864, which President Clinton signed earlier in 1993. No summary was provided, so the specific changes cannot be described here. Records suggest Order 12864 set up a presidential advisory council on the nation's information networks, but the title alone does not confirm this.
when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 30, 1993. The title does not state a separate start date.
